registers.name: CTRL_MODE
registers.description: Operating mode control register. Software-visible mode selection for the safety/control wrapper.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Operating mode control. Encodings are implementation-defined but must remain stable for software.

registers.name: CTRL_FORMAT
registers.description: Packet format version register. Configures the accepted command packet format version.

registers.name: WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT
registers.description: Watchdog and freshness timeout threshold in cycles.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Programmable watchdog timeout threshold in cycles. Accepted commands reload the watchdog; idle beyond this count inhibits actuator validity.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN
fields.description: Minimum clamp applied to actuator command outputs before driving actuator_cmd_out.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX
fields.description: Maximum clamp applied to actuator command outputs before driving actuator_cmd_out.

registers.name: FAULT_CLEAR
registers.description: Write-one strobe that requests fault clear.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULTS
fields.description: Write-one pulse request that clears latched faults in the safety controller.

registers.name: STATUS_SUMMARY
registers.description: Readable summary of acceptance, rejection, clamp, and inhibit state.

fields.name: ACCEPTED_PULSE
fields.description: Acceptance pulse indication from the last evaluated command.

fields.name: REJECTED_PULSE
fields.description: Rejection pulse indication from the last evaluated command.

fields.name: CLAMPED_OUTPUT
fields.description: Indicates the actuator request was clamped to the configured bounds.

fields.name: INHIBIT_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates actuator output validity is inhibited due to timeout or fault conditions.

fields.name: FAULT_STATUS_MIRROR
fields.description: Mirror of the latched fault vector.

fields.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQUENCE_MIRROR
fields.description: Mirror of the last accepted sequence number.

init_sequence: Program CTRL_MODE to the desired operating mode.
Program CTRL_FORMAT with the expected packet format version.
Program WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT with the desired freshness/watchdog threshold.
Program CLAMP_MIN and CLAMP_MAX with bounded actuator limits.
If needed, write FAULT_CLEAR with 1 to clear latched faults after configuration.
Verify FAULT_STATUS, SEQ_LAST_ACCEPTED, and STATUS_SUMMARY read back as expected.
polling_sequence: Poll FAULT_STATUS for stale, timeout, checksum, and range faults.
Poll SEQ_LAST_ACCEPTED to observe the most recently accepted command sequence.
Poll STATUS_SUMMARY for acceptance/rejection, clamp, and inhibit indications.
If the status stream is enabled in the system, correlate CSR reads with telemetry packets.
irq_sequence: No interrupt source is defined in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
Use CSR polling and the status stream for fault and acceptance observation.

consistency_notes: The register map is compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON and exposes only registers and fields that are explicitly described there.
The CSR/MMIO interface is treated as a reachable abstract control-plane window with address, write-data, read-data, valid, write-enable, and ready/response semantics.
No unsupported bus protocol is invented.
All field bit ranges use lsb <= msb.
No fallback command or substitute actuation is defined; invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions only inhibit actuator validity and preserve latched faults for software handling.
